title: Searching a binary search tree for 6

steps.caption: In a BST, everything left of a node is smaller and everything right is larger. Search for 6, starting at the root.
6 < 8, so the whole right subtree is out. Go left.
6 > 3, so the left child (1) is out. Go right.
Found 6 after 3 comparisons. Each comparison discards a whole subtree, so the cost is the tree height: O(log n) if balanced, O(n) if it is a chain.
